title: Solve sampled equations with a backend
statement: Given a binary-field linear solver backend, natural numbers $n$, $\ell$, and $m$, and $m$ samples, each consisting of a point of the $n$-dimensional binary cube and a bit, define a degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient assignment by applying the backend's solver to the linear equations constructed from those samples.
